hypothesis: Fuse local target extraction, global-max shift, exponentiation, exp storage, target mask, predicted contribution, and local denominator into one row-per-block prepare kernel.
scope: Optimize one local stage only; preserve caller collectives and ABI.
expected_effect: Reduce PyTorch-style local kernel launch and temporary overhead while retaining FP32 arithmetic and exact global-max shift semantics.
risks: Different FP32 summation order may cause small numerical drift
One block per row may underutilize the GPU for very large row counts
